title: Ephyra · Jellyware exploration
description: Thirty generated concepts, three generations. Designer assessment using inferred on-call, reviewer, and handoff personas; not a user study. Multiplayer presence in images is a design proposal. Implementation uses actual sample evidence and explicitly local demo collaboration.

concepts.name: Tidal Desk
concepts.mutation: Initial diverse concept
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high fidelity desktop product interface concept for EPHYRA, self-hosted self-driving software. This is a real engineering workspace, not a landing page. Jellyware: soft enough to change, firm enough to trust. An on-call engineer and reviewer collaborate with an agent on trail T-4c1e0f, 'Checkout total off by a cent'. Human checkpoint C is waiting. Show evidence, failing-before/passing-after proof, 412 tests, review conversation, named teammate presence and clear checkpoint ownership, contextual tools and 'Approve and land'. Label 'Sample workspace'. Use legible humanist sans, discreet monospace identifiers. Marine organic softness, subtle mint waiting, amber accepted, cherry rollback. Avoid rectangular card grids, rigid dashboard boxes, neon cyberpunk, decorative giant jellyfish, illegible low-contrast glass. High visual craft, usable density, believable controls, 1536x1024 landscape composition. No device frame. Concept g1-01, tidal_desk: Continuous pale seafoam work surface, broad open typography, irregular gently rounded edges only at the outer boundary, low-profile floating tool dock. Collaborative notes as small anchored ripples at relevant evidence. Main proof is an open typographic document.
concepts.assessment: Clear shared review and tool access; flowing surface works, but small boxes and generic nav remain.
